appeal_intro: If your account was suspended, you can contest the decision here. Use the appeal link from the notice email.
appeal_entry_help: Paste the full link from the notice email.
appeal_invalid_link: That does not look like an appeal link. Check the email and try again.
appeal_statement_help: Explain why you believe the decision is wrong. Up to 2000 characters.
appeal_statement_invalid: Write a statement of 1 to 2000 characters.
appeal_received: Your appeal was received. A moderator will review it, and the decision is targeted within 7 days.
appeal_error: We could not send your appeal. Try again shortly.
